source.text: פִּצְח֤וּ רַנְּנוּ֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו חָרְב֖וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּֽי־נִחַ֤ם יְהוָה֙ עַמּ֔וֹ גָּאַ֖ל יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Break forth, shout for joy together, O ruins of Jerusalem, for has comforted Yahweh his people; he has redeemed Jerusalem.

en.L: Break out, sing for joy together, ruins of Jerusalem, \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has comforted {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has redeemed Jerusalem.
en.B: You ruined places of Jerusalem, break into song; shout for joy, all of you together! \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has brought comfort to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has redeemed Jerusalem.
en.R: Ruins of Jerusalem, shout and sing for joy together! \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has comforted {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people. \q He has bought back Jerusalem.

es.L: ¡{{plural_you:Prorrumpan, canten|Prorrumpid, cantad}} de júbilo a una, ruinas de Jerusalén! \q Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha consolado a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha redimido a Jerusalén.
es.B: Lugares en ruinas de Jerusalén, ¡{{plural_you:estallen|estallad}} en cantos; {{plural_you:griten|gritad}} de alegría todos juntos! \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha traído consuelo a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha redimido a Jerusalén.
es.R: ¡Ruinas de Jerusalén, {{plural_you:griten y canten|gritad y cantad}} juntas de alegría! \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha consolado a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo. \q Él ha rescatado a Jerusalén.

fr.L: Éclatez, criez de joie ensemble, ruines de Jérusalem, \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a consolé {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a racheté Jérusalem.
fr.B: Lieux en ruine de Jérusalem, éclatez en chants ; criez de joie, tous ensemble ! \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a consolé {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a racheté Jérusalem.
fr.R: Ruines de Jérusalem, criez et chantez de joie ensemble ! \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a consolé {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple. \q Il a racheté Jérusalem.

sw.L: Pazeni sauti, imbeni kwa furaha pamoja, enyi magofu ya Yerusalemu, \q kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewafariji watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}; \q ameukomboa Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Enyi mahali palipoharibiwa pa Yerusalemu, anzeni kuimba; pigeni vigelegele nyote pamoja! \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewaletea watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} faraja; \q ameukomboa Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Enyi magofu ya Yerusalemu, pigeni kelele na kuimba kwa furaha pamoja! \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewafariji watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. \q Ameununua Yerusalemu tena.

vi.L: Hãy bật lên, hãy cùng nhau hát mừng, hỡi những nơi đổ nát của Giê-ru-sa-lem, \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã an ủi dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã cứu chuộc Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Hỡi những nơi đổ nát của Giê-ru-sa-lem, hãy cất tiếng hát; hãy cùng nhau reo vui! \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đem niềm an ủi đến cho dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã cứu chuộc Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Hỡi những nơi đổ nát của Giê-ru-sa-lem, hãy cùng nhau reo hò và ca hát vui mừng! \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã an ủi dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Ngài đã chuộc lại Giê-ru-sa-lem.

ko.L: 예루살렘의 폐허들아, 함께 터져 나오듯 기뻐 노래하여라. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 백성을 위로하셨고, \q 예루살렘을 구속하셨다.
ko.B: 폐허가 된 예루살렘의 모든 곳들아, 노래를 터뜨려라. 다 함께 기뻐 외쳐라! \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 백성에게 위로를 주셨고, \q 예루살렘을 구속하셨다.
ko.R: 예루살렘의 무너진 곳들아, 다 함께 기뻐 외치며 노래하여라! \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 백성을 위로하셨다. \q 그분이 값을 치르고 예루살렘을 되찾으셨다.

pt.L: Rompam, cantem de alegria juntas, ruínas de Jerusalém, \q pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} consolou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} redimiu Jerusalém.
pt.B: Lugares arruinados de Jerusalém, rompam em canto; gritem de alegria, todos juntos! \q {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} trouxe consolo ao {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} redimiu Jerusalém.
pt.R: Ruínas de Jerusalém, gritem e cantem de alegria, todas juntas! \q {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} consolou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo. \q Ele resgatou Jerusalém.

am.L: የኢየሩሳሌም ፍርስራሾች ሆይ፣ በአንድነት እልል በሉ፤ ዘምሩ፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሕዝቡን አጽናንቷልና፤ \q ኢየሩሳሌምን ተቤዥቷል።
am.B: እናንተ የፈረሳችሁ የኢየሩሳሌም ስፍራዎች፣ በዝማሬ ፈንድቁ፤ ሁላችሁም በአንድነት እልል በሉ! \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሕዝቡን አጽናንቷል፤ \q ኢየሩሳሌምን ተቤዥቷል።
am.R: የኢየሩሳሌም ፍርስራሾች ሆይ፣ በአንድነት በደስታ ጩኹ፤ ዘምሩም! \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሕዝቡን አጽናንቷል። \q ኢየሩሳሌምን መልሶ ገዝቷታል።

hi.L: हे यरूशलेम के खंडहरो, एक साथ जयजयकार करते हुए फूट पड़ो, \q क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने अपनी प्रजा को शान्ति दी है; \q उन्होंने यरूशलेम को छुड़ा लिया है।
hi.B: हे यरूशलेम के उजड़े स्थानो, गीत गा उठो; तुम सब मिलकर जयजयकार करो! \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने अपनी प्रजा को शान्ति दी है; \q उन्होंने यरूशलेम को छुड़ा लिया है।
hi.R: हे यरूशलेम के खंडहरो, मिलकर जयजयकार करो और आनंद से गाओ! \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने अपनी प्रजा को शान्ति दी है। \q उन्होंने यरूशलेम को छुड़ा लिया है।

ru.L: Разразитесь, ликуйте вместе, развалины Иерусалима, \q ведь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} утешил свой народ; \q {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} искупил Иерусалим.
ru.B: Разрушенные места Иерусалима, разразитесь песней; ликуйте все вместе! \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} утешил свой народ; \q {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} искупил Иерусалим.
ru.R: Развалины Иерусалима, кричите и пойте от радости все вместе! \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} утешил свой народ. \q Он выкупил Иерусалим.

ja.L: 声を放ち、共に喜び歌え、エルサレムの廃墟よ。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がご自分の民を慰め、 \q エルサレムを贖われたからだ。
ja.B: エルサレムの荒れ果てた所よ、声を放って歌いなさい。共に喜びの声を上げなさい。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がご自分の民を慰め、 \q エルサレムを贖われたのだ。
ja.R: エルサレムの廃墟よ、一緒に叫んで、喜び歌いなさい！ \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がご自分の民を慰めてくださった。 \q エルサレムを買い戻してくださった。

decisions.choice: the LORD has comforted his people: the comfort promised at 40:1 has come
decisions.reason: The second half of Isaiah opens with "Comfort, comfort my people" (40:1), and the theme returns in 49:13 and 51:3, 12. Here the comfort is announced as done.

decisions.choice: has comforted ... has redeemed: future rescue spoken of as already accomplished
decisions.reason: The verbs are past in form, though Jerusalem still lies in ruins. The prophet speaks of what God will do as so certain that it can be told as done (compare 44:23; 49:13).

decisions.choice: ruins of Jerusalem: the city's ruined places, told to sing
decisions.reason: Jerusalem was destroyed by Babylon in 587 BC. The ruins themselves are called to rejoice, as mountains and trees are elsewhere (44:23; 49:13; 55:12).

decisions.choice: nicham YHWH 'ammo "主がご自分の民を慰め", the comfort of 40:1 ("慰めよ") come true (m1), and as 49:13; hymn forms "〜せよ" (L), "〜しなさい" (B, R).
decisions.reason: The same verb as 40:1 and 49:13.

source.text: חָשַׂ֤ף יְהוָה֙ אֶת־זְר֣וֹעַ קָדְשׁ֔וֹ לְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־הַגּוֹיִ֑ם וְרָאוּ֙ כָּל־אַפְסֵי־אָ֔רֶץ אֵ֖ת יְשׁוּעַ֥ת אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Has bared Yahweh the arm of his holiness to the eyes of all the nations, and will see all [the] ends of [the] earth the salvation of our God.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has bared {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy arm before the eyes of all the nations, \q and all the ends of the earth will see the salvation of our God.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has stripped bare {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy arm in full view of every nation, \q and the whole earth, to its farthest edges, will see the salvation of our God.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is ready to act. He has shown {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy power to all the nations. \q People in the farthest places on earth will see how our God saves.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha desnudado {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santo brazo ante los ojos de todas las naciones, \q y todos los confines de la tierra verán la salvación de nuestro Dios.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha descubierto {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santo brazo a la vista de todas las naciones, \q y toda la tierra, hasta sus confines más lejanos, verá la salvación de nuestro Dios.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} está listo para actuar. Ha mostrado {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santo poder a todas las naciones. \q La gente de los lugares más lejanos de la tierra verá cómo salva nuestro Dios.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dénudé {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} bras saint aux yeux de toutes les nations, \q et toutes les extrémités de la terre verront le salut de notre Dieu.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a mis à nu {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} bras saint sous les yeux de toutes les nations, \q et la terre entière, jusqu’à ses extrémités, verra le salut de notre Dieu.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est prêt à agir. Il a montré {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sainte puissance à toutes les nations. \q Les gens des endroits les plus lointains de la terre verront comment notre Dieu sauve.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameufunua mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mtakatifu mbele ya macho ya mataifa yote, \q na miisho yote ya dunia itaona wokovu wa Mungu wetu.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameuweka wazi mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mtakatifu mbele ya kila taifa, \q na dunia nzima, hadi pembe zake za mbali, itaona wokovu wa Mungu wetu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yuko tayari kutenda. Ameonyesha uweza {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mtakatifu kwa mataifa yote. \q Watu walio mahali pa mbali kabisa duniani wataona jinsi Mungu wetu anavyookoa.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã để trần cánh tay thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trước mắt mọi dân tộc, \q và mọi đầu cùng đất sẽ thấy sự cứu rỗi của Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã xắn tay áo, để lộ cánh tay thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trước mặt mọi dân tộc, \q và khắp trái đất, đến tận cùng, sẽ thấy sự cứu rỗi của Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã sẵn sàng hành động. Ngài đã tỏ quyền năng thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho mọi dân tộc thấy. \q Người ở những nơi xa nhất trên đất sẽ thấy Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta giải cứu thế nào.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 모든 민족의 눈앞에서 그분의 거룩한 팔을 걷어붙이셨으니, \q 땅의 모든 끝이 우리 하나님의 구원을 볼 것이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 모든 민족이 보는 앞에서 그분의 거룩한 팔을 드러내셨으니, \q 온 땅이 그 가장 먼 끝까지 우리 하나님의 구원을 볼 것이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 일하실 준비를 하셨다. 그분이 모든 민족에게 그분의 거룩한 능력을 보여 주셨다. \q 땅의 가장 먼 곳에 사는 사람들도 우리 하나님께서 어떻게 구원하시는지 보게 될 것이다.

pt.L: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} pôs a nu o braço da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} santidade aos olhos de todas as nações, \q e todas as extremidades da terra verão a salvação do nosso Deus.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} arregaçou a manga e mostrou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} braço santo a todas as nações, \q e a terra inteira, até os seus lugares mais distantes, verá a salvação do nosso Deus.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} está pronto para agir. Ele mostrou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} santo poder a todas as nações. \q As pessoas nos lugares mais distantes da terra vão ver como o nosso Deus salva.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በሕዝቦች ሁሉ ዓይን ፊት ቅዱስ ክንዱን ገለጠ፤ \q የምድር ዳርቻዎችም ሁሉ የአምላካችንን ማዳን ያያሉ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በሕዝቦች ሁሉ ፊት ቅዱስ ክንዱን ገልጦ አሳየ፤ \q እስከ ዳርቻዋ ድረስ ምድር ሁሉ የአምላካችንን ማዳን ታያለች።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለመሥራት ተዘጋጅቷል። ቅዱስ ኃይሉን ለሕዝቦች ሁሉ አሳይቷል። \q በምድር ዳርቻ ያሉ ሰዎችም አምላካችን እንዴት እንደሚያድን ያያሉ።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने सब जातियों की आँखों के सामने अपनी पवित्र भुजा उघाड़ी है, \q और पृथ्वी के सब छोर हमारे परमेश्वर का उद्धार देखेंगे।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने सब देशों के देखते-देखते अपनी पवित्र भुजा खोल दी है, \q और सारी पृथ्वी, उसके दूर से दूर छोर तक, हमारे परमेश्वर का उद्धार देखेगी।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} काम करने को तैयार हैं। उन्होंने सब देशों को अपनी पवित्र शक्ति दिखाई है। \q पृथ्वी के सबसे दूर के स्थानों के लोग भी देखेंगे कि हमारे परमेश्वर कैसे बचाते हैं।

ru.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} обнажил свою святую руку перед глазами всех народов, \q и все концы земли увидят спасение нашего Бога.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} обнажил свою святую руку на виду у всех народов, \q и вся земля, до самых дальних краёв, увидит спасение нашего Бога.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} готов действовать. Он показал свою святую силу всем народам. \q Люди в самых дальних местах земли увидят, как спасает наш Бог.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、すべての国々の目の前に、その聖なる腕をあらわにされた。 \q 地のすべての果てが、わたしたちの神の救いを見る。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、あらゆる国々が見ている前で、その聖なる腕をむき出しにされた。 \q 地の果てに至るまで、全地がわたしたちの神の救いを見る。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、行動を起こす用意ができておられる。その方は、ご自分の聖なる力を、すべての国々に示された。 \q 地の果てに住む人々も、わたしたちの神がどのように救ってくださるかを見る。

decisions.choice: bared his holy arm: God gets ready to act in power
decisions.reason: A warrior or worker pulls back his robe to free his arm for action (Ezekiel 4:7). God's arm stands for his strength to rescue (40:10; 51:9; 53:1). "Holy" marks the power as God's own.

decisions.choice: all the ends of the earth will see the salvation of our God
decisions.reason: Psalm 98:2-3 uses the same words: "all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God." What God does for Zion is done before the whole world (40:5; 49:6).

decisions.choice: is ready to act ... has shown his holy power
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of baring the arm instead of reproducing it.

decisions.choice: how our God saves
decisions.reason: Readable uses the verb "save" for the noun "salvation", as the settled wording allows.

decisions.choice: arregaçou a manga e mostrou o seu braço santo
decisions.reason: The picture is of a man pulling back his sleeve to free his arm for work or battle (m1). Brazilian Portuguese has that very picture in "arregaçar as mangas", to get ready for hard work, so Balanced uses it and keeps the arm; "desnudar o braço" is not said in Portuguese.

source.text: ס֤וּרוּ ס֨וּרוּ֙ צְא֣וּ מִשָּׁ֔ם טָמֵ֖א אַל־תִּגָּ֑עוּ צְא֣וּ מִתּוֹכָ֔הּ הִבָּ֕רוּ נֹשְׂאֵ֖י כְּלֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Depart, depart, go out from there; unclean do not touch; go out from its midst; purify yourselves, [you who] carry the vessels of Yahweh.

en.L: Depart, depart, go out from there! \q Do not touch [anything] unclean; \q go out from the midst of her; \q purify yourselves, [you who] carry the vessels of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Depart, depart, get out of there! \q Touch nothing unclean. \q Leave from the midst of her and make yourselves pure, \q you who bear the vessels of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Leave! Leave! Get out of Babylon! \q Do not touch anything unclean. \q Get out of that city and make yourselves pure, \q you who carry the things used to worship {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: ¡{{plural_you:Apártense, apártense, salgan|Apartaos, apartaos, salid}} de allí! \q No {{plural_you:toquen|toquéis}} [cosa] impura; \q {{plural_you:salgan|salid}} de en medio de ella; \q {{plural_you:purifíquense|purificaos}}, los que llevan los utensilios {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Váyanse, váyanse, salgan|Idos, idos, salid}} de allí! \q No {{plural_you:toquen|toquéis}} nada impuro. \q {{plural_you:Salgan|Salid}} de en medio de ella y {{plural_you:purifíquense|purificaos}}, \q {{plural_you:ustedes que llevan|vosotros que lleváis}} los utensilios {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Váyanse|Idos}}! ¡{{plural_you:Váyanse|Idos}}! ¡{{plural_you:Salgan|Salid}} de Babilonia! \q No {{plural_you:toquen|toquéis}} nada impuro. \q {{plural_you:Salgan|Salid}} de esa ciudad y {{plural_you:purifíquense|purificaos}}, \q {{plural_you:ustedes que llevan|vosotros que lleváis}} las cosas que se usan para adorar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Partez, partez, sortez de là ! \q Ne touchez rien d’impur ; \q sortez du milieu d’elle ; \q purifiez-vous, [vous] qui portez les vases {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Partez, partez, sortez de là ! \q Ne touchez à rien d’impur. \q Sortez du milieu d’elle et purifiez-vous, \q vous qui portez les vases {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Partez ! Partez ! Sortez de Babylone ! \q Ne touchez à rien d’impur. \q Sortez de cette ville et purifiez-vous, \q vous qui portez les objets qui servent au culte {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Ondokeni, ondokeni, tokeni huko! \q Msiguse [kitu] kilicho najisi; \q tokeni katikati yake; \q jitakaseni, [ninyi] mnaobeba vyombo vya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Ondokeni, ondokeni, tokeni huko! \q Msiguse kitu chochote kilicho najisi. \q Tokeni katikati yake na kujitakasa, \q ninyi mnaobeba vyombo vya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Ondokeni! Ondokeni! Tokeni Babeli! \q Msiguse kitu chochote kilicho najisi. \q Tokeni katika mji ule na kujitakasa, \q ninyi mnaobeba vyombo vinavyotumika kumwabudu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Hãy đi, hãy đi, hãy ra khỏi đó! \q Đừng đụng đến [vật gì] ô uế; \q hãy ra khỏi giữa nó; \q hãy tẩy sạch mình, [hỡi những người] mang các khí cụ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Hãy đi, hãy đi, hãy ra khỏi nơi đó! \q Đừng chạm đến vật ô uế. \q Hãy ra khỏi giữa thành và giữ mình cho tinh sạch, \q hỡi những người khiêng các khí cụ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Hãy đi! Hãy đi! Hãy ra khỏi Ba-by-lôn! \q Đừng chạm vào bất cứ thứ gì ô uế. \q Hãy ra khỏi thành ấy và giữ mình cho tinh sạch, \q hỡi những người mang các vật dụng dùng để thờ phượng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 떠나라, 떠나라, 거기서 나오너라! \q 부정한 것을 만지지 마라. \q 그 가운데서 나오너라. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 기구들을 메는 [너희는] 스스로 정결하게 하여라.
ko.B: 떠나라, 떠나라, 그곳에서 나오너라! \q 부정한 것은 아무것도 만지지 마라. \q 그 가운데서 나와 몸을 정결하게 하여라. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 기구들을 메고 가는 자들아.
ko.R: 떠나라! 떠나라! 바빌론에서 나오너라! \q 부정한 것은 아무것도 만지지 마라. \q 그 성에서 나와서 몸을 깨끗하게 하여라. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 예배할 때 쓰는 기구들을 나르는 사람들아.

pt.L: Afastem-se, afastem-se, saiam dali! \q Não toquem [em nada] impuro; \q saiam do meio dela; \q purifiquem-se, [vocês que] carregam os utensílios {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: Vão embora, vão embora, saiam de lá! \q Não toquem no que é impuro. \q Saiam do meio dela e se purifiquem, \q vocês que levam os utensílios {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Saiam! Saiam! Saiam da Babilônia! \q Não toquem em nada que seja impuro. \q Saiam daquela cidade e se purifiquem, \q vocês que carregam as coisas usadas na adoração {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.

am.L: ራቁ፣ ራቁ፤ ከዚያ ውጡ! \q ርኩስን አትንኩ፤ \q ከመካከሏ ውጡ፤ \q {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ዕቃዎች የምትሸከሙ ሆይ፣ ራሳችሁን አንጹ።
am.B: ራቁ፣ ራቁ፤ ከዚያ ውጡ! \q ርኩስ የሆነውን አትንኩ። \q ከመካከሏ ውጡ፤ ራሳችሁንም አንጹ፤ \q እናንተ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ዕቃዎች የምትሸከሙ።
am.R: ሂዱ! ሂዱ! ከባቢሎን ውጡ! \q ርኩስ የሆነውን ምንም ነገር አትንኩ። \q ከዚያች ከተማ ውጡ፤ ራሳችሁንም አንጹ፤ \q እናንተ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ለማምለክ የሚያገለግሉትን ዕቃዎች የምትሸከሙ።

hi.L: दूर हो, दूर हो, वहाँ से निकल आओ! \q [किसी] अशुद्ध वस्तु को न छुओ; \q उसके बीच में से निकल आओ; \q अपने को शुद्ध करो, [तुम जो] {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के पात्र उठाते हो।
hi.B: दूर हो, दूर हो, वहाँ से निकल आओ! \q जो अशुद्ध है उसे न छुओ। \q उसके बीच से निकल आओ और अपने को शुद्ध करो, \q तुम जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के पात्र उठाकर ले जाते हो।
hi.R: निकलो! निकलो! बाबुल से निकल आओ! \q किसी ऐसी चीज़ को न छुओ जो तुम्हें अशुद्ध कर दे। \q उस नगर से निकल आओ और अपने को शुद्ध करो, \q तुम जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की आराधना की वस्तुएँ उठाकर ले जाते हो।

ru.L: Уходите, уходите, выйдите оттуда! \q К нечистому не прикасайтесь; \q выйдите из среды её; \q очиститесь, носящие сосуды {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Уходите, уходите, выходите оттуда! \q Не прикасайтесь к нечистому. \q Выйдите из её среды и очиститесь, \q вы, несущие сосуды {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Уходите! Уходите! Выйдите из Вавилона! \q Не прикасайтесь ни к чему, что сделало бы вас нечистыми. \q Выйдите из среды этого города и очиститесь, \q вы, кто несёт вещи для поклонения {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}.

ja.L: 去れ、去れ、そこから出よ。 \q 汚れたものに触れるな。 \q その中から出よ。 \q 身を清めよ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の器を担う者たちよ。
ja.B: 去りなさい、去りなさい。そこから出て行きなさい。 \q 汚れたものに触れてはならない。 \q その中から出て行き、身を清めなさい、 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の器を運ぶ者たちよ。
ja.R: 去りなさい！去りなさい！バビロンから出て行きなさい！ \q 汚れたものに触れてはいけない。 \q その町から出て行き、身を清めなさい。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を礼拝するときに使う物を運ぶ人たちよ。

decisions.choice: from there ... from her midst: from Babylon
decisions.reason: The place is not named here, but 48:20 has the same call: "Go out from Babylon." Paul applies the call to believers in 2 Corinthians 6:17: come out and be separate, and touch nothing unclean.

decisions.choice: the vessels of the LORD: the temple's sacred vessels, carried home
decisions.reason: Nebuchadnezzar took the temple vessels to Babylon (2 Kings 25:13-15), and Cyrus sent them back with the returning exiles (Ezra 1:7-11). Only those set apart for it might carry holy things (Numbers 4:15), so the bearers must be pure.

decisions.choice: touch nothing unclean; purify yourselves: the departure is a holy procession
decisions.reason: The return home is pictured as a march of worship, not a flight. The people leave behind the uncleanness of an idol-worshiping land.

decisions.choice: Get out of Babylon
decisions.reason: Readable names the place, following 48:20.

decisions.choice: Não toquem [em nada] impuro (L), Não toquem no que é impuro (B); saiam do meio dela, as 2 Corinthians 6:17
decisions.reason: Paul applies this call in 2 Corinthians 6:17 (m1), so the shared words keep its Portuguese at each level: "saiam do meio", "não toquem [em nada] impuro" (L), "não toquem no que é impuro" (B). The command is to the exiles as a group, so "vocês", as Corinthians has it.

decisions.choice: 2 Corinthians 6:17 kept: "ርኩስን አትንኩ" (L), "ርኩስ የሆነውን አትንኩ" (B, R); "ከመካከሏ ውጡ" follows the Hebrew
decisions.reason: Paul quotes this verse freely (2 Corinthians 6:17). The Amharic keeps his "touch nothing unclean" and "go out from the midst", but the Hebrew "her" (Babylon) where Paul has "them", and it keeps the Hebrew "depart, depart" and the vessels of the LORD, which Paul leaves out.

decisions.choice: अशुद्ध वस्तु को न छुओ; उसके बीच में से निकल आओ
decisions.reason: 2 Corinthians 6:17 takes up this call; its wording ("निकल आओ", "अशुद्ध ... न छुओ") is kept at each level where the Hebrew says the same.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Corinthians 6:17 at each level (к нечистому не прикасайтесь, выйдите из среды; не прикасайтесь к нечистому, выйдите из ... среды; не прикасайтесь ни к чему, что сделало бы вас нечистыми)
decisions.reason: Paul quotes these lines in 2 Corinthians 6:17 and the Hebrew agrees in "touch nothing unclean" and "go out from her midst", so Russian keeps his words there. Paul's "be separate" stands where the Hebrew has "purify yourselves", which is translated as it stands (очиститесь).

decisions.choice: Commands "〜せよ / 〜するな" (L), "〜しなさい / 〜してはならない" (B), "〜してはいけない" (R), as ISA-1; mittokhah "その中から" (L, B), not "彼女". Checked against 2CO 6:17 ("出て行き、離れなさい … 汚れたものに触れてはならない"); drafted from the Hebrew, which has two "depart" and no "be separate".
decisions.reason: Paul's Greek wording differs; the Hebrew is followed.

source.text: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א בְחִפָּזוֹן֙ תֵּצֵ֔אוּ וּבִמְנוּסָ֖ה לֹ֣א תֵלֵכ֑וּן כִּֽי־הֹלֵ֤ךְ לִפְנֵיכֶם֙ יְהוָ֔ה וּמְאַסִּפְכֶ֖ם אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

records.literal_gloss: For not in haste will you go out, and in flight not you will go, for [is] going before you Yahweh, and your rear guard [is the] God of Israel.

en.L: For not in haste will you go out, \q and in flight you will not go, \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] going before you, \q and the God of Israel [is] your rear guard.
en.B: For you will not leave in a rush, \q nor go off like runaways. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} walks at your head, \q and the God of Israel guards you from behind.
en.R: You will not have to hurry away or run for your lives. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will lead you, \q and the God of Israel will protect you from behind.

es.L: Porque no {{plural_you:saldrán|saldréis}} con prisa, \q ni {{plural_you:irán|iréis}} huyendo, \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [va] delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, \q y el Dios de Israel [es] {{plural_you:su retaguardia|vuestra retaguardia}}.
es.B: Porque no {{plural_you:saldrán|saldréis}} apresurados, \q ni se {{plural_you:irán|iréis}} como fugitivos. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} marcha al frente de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, \q y el Dios de Israel {{plural_you:los|os}} guarda por detrás.
es.R: No {{plural_you:tendrán|tendréis}} que irse deprisa ni huir para salvar la vida. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:los|os}} guiará, \q y el Dios de Israel {{plural_you:los|os}} protegerá por detrás.

fr.L: Car vous ne sortirez pas avec précipitation, \q et vous ne partirez pas en fuyant, \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} marche devant vous, \q et le Dieu d’Israël [est] votre arrière-garde.
fr.B: Car vous ne partirez pas en hâte, \q vous ne vous en irez pas comme des fuyards. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} marche à votre tête, \q et le Dieu d’Israël vous protège par-derrière.
fr.R: Vous n’aurez pas besoin de partir en vitesse ni de vous enfuir pour sauver votre vie. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous conduira, \q et le Dieu d’Israël vous protégera par-derrière.

sw.L: Kwa maana hamtatoka kwa haraka, \q wala hamtakwenda kwa kukimbia, \q kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [anatangulia] mbele yenu, \q na Mungu wa Israeli [ni] mlinzi wenu wa nyuma.
sw.B: Kwa maana hamtaondoka kwa pupa, \q wala hamtakwenda kama watoro. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anatembea mbele yenu, \q na Mungu wa Israeli anawalinda kutoka nyuma.
sw.R: Hamtalazimika kuondoka kwa haraka au kukimbia kuokoa maisha yenu. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawaongoza, \q na Mungu wa Israeli atawalinda kutoka nyuma.

vi.L: Vì các ngươi sẽ không ra đi vội vã, \q và các ngươi sẽ không đi như kẻ chạy trốn, \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [đang] đi trước các ngươi, \q và Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên [là] hậu quân của các ngươi.
vi.B: Vì các ngươi sẽ không phải ra đi hối hả, \q cũng chẳng phải đi như kẻ trốn chạy. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đi trước dẫn đầu các ngươi, \q và Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên bảo vệ phía sau các ngươi.
vi.R: Các ngươi sẽ không phải vội vã ra đi hay chạy trốn để giữ mạng sống. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ dẫn đường cho các ngươi, \q và Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ bảo vệ các ngươi từ phía sau.

ko.L: 참으로 너희는 서둘러 나가지 않고, \q 도망하듯 가지 않을 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희 앞에서 가시고, \q 이스라엘의 하나님께서 너희의 뒤를 지키시기 때문이다.
ko.B: 너희는 허둥지둥 떠나지 않을 것이고, \q 도망치는 사람처럼 달아나지도 않을 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희 앞에서 걸어가시고, \q 이스라엘의 하나님께서 뒤에서 너희를 지켜 주신다.
ko.R: 너희는 서둘러 떠나거나 목숨을 건지려고 달아날 필요가 없다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희를 앞에서 이끄시고, \q 이스라엘의 하나님께서 뒤에서 너희를 지켜 주실 것이다.

pt.L: Pois não com pressa vocês sairão, \q e em fuga não irão, \q pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} [vai] adiante de vocês, \q e o Deus de Israel [é] a retaguarda de vocês.
pt.B: Vocês não sairão às pressas, \q nem partirão como fugitivos. \q {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} caminha à frente de vocês, \q e o Deus de Israel os protege pela retaguarda.
pt.R: Vocês não vão precisar sair correndo nem fugir para salvar a vida. \q {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} vai guiar vocês, \q e o Deus de Israel vai proteger vocês por trás.

am.L: በችኮላ አትወጡምና፤ \q በሽሽትም አትሄዱም፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በፊታችሁ ይሄዳልና፤ \q የእስራኤል አምላክም ደጀናችሁ [ነው]።
am.B: በጥድፊያ አትወጡም፤ \q እንደ ኮብላዮችም አትሄዱም። \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በፊታችሁ ይሄዳል፤ \q የእስራኤል አምላክም ከኋላችሁ ይጠብቃችኋል።
am.R: መቸኮል ወይም ሕይወታችሁን ለማዳን መሮጥ አያስፈልጋችሁም። \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይመራችኋል፤ \q የእስራኤል አምላክም ከኋላ ይጠብቃችኋል።

hi.L: क्योंकि तुम उतावली से नहीं निकलोगे, \q और न भागते हुए चलोगे, \q क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे आगे-आगे चल रहे हैं, \q और इस्राएल के परमेश्वर तुम्हारे पीछे के रक्षक [हैं]।
hi.B: तुम हड़बड़ी में नहीं निकलोगे, \q न भगोड़ों की तरह चलोगे। \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे आगे-आगे चलते हैं, \q और इस्राएल के परमेश्वर पीछे से तुम्हारी रक्षा करते हैं।
hi.R: तुम्हें जल्दी में भागना या जान बचाकर दौड़ना नहीं पड़ेगा। \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारी अगुवाई करेंगे, \q और इस्राएल के परमेश्वर पीछे से तुम्हारी रक्षा करेंगे।

ru.L: Ведь не в спешке вы выйдете \q и не бегством пойдёте, \q ведь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} идёт перед вами, \q и Бог Израиля — ваша задняя стража.
ru.B: Вы не уйдёте в спешке \q и не побежите, как беглецы. \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} идёт впереди вас, \q и Бог Израиля охраняет вас сзади.
ru.R: Вам не придётся торопливо уходить или спасаться бегством. \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} поведёт вас, \q и Бог Израиля защитит вас сзади.

ja.L: あなたがたは急いで出ることはなく、 \q 逃げるようにして行くこともない。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}があなたがたの前を進み、 \q イスラエルの神があなたがたのしんがりとなられるからだ。
ja.B: あなたがたは慌てて出て行くのではない。 \q 逃げる者のように去るのでもない。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}があなたがたの先頭を歩み、 \q イスラエルの神が後ろからあなたがたを守られる。
ja.R: あなたたちは、急いで出て行く必要も、命からがら逃げる必要もない。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}があなたたちを導き、 \q イスラエルの神が後ろからあなたたちを守ってくださる。

decisions.choice: not in haste: unlike the first exodus
decisions.reason: Israel ate the first Passover in haste and left Egypt in haste (Exodus 12:11; Deuteronomy 16:3). This going out will be calm and unhurried.

decisions.choice: going before you ... your rear guard: God leads and protects the march
decisions.reason: In the exodus the pillar of cloud went before Israel and then moved behind them to guard them (Exodus 13:21; 14:19). 58:8 uses the same word for rear guard.

decisions.choice: lo' vechippazon "急いで…ことはなく" (L), "慌てて" (B): unlike the haste of the first exodus (m1; EXO 12:11).
decisions.reason: The exodus echo is kept in the plain verb.

source.text: הִנֵּ֥ה יַשְׂכִּ֖יל עַבְדִּ֑י יָר֧וּם וְנִשָּׂ֛א וְגָבַ֖הּ מְאֹֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, will act wisely my servant; he will be high and he will be lifted up, and he will be exalted exceedingly.

en.L: Look, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant will act wisely; \q he will be high and lifted up, and exalted exceedingly.
en.B: Look, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant will act with insight and succeed. \q He will rise and be lifted up; he will stand very high.
en.R: Look! My servant will do what is wise, and he will succeed. \q He will be raised up and honored. He will be given the highest place.

es.L: {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo obrará sabiamente; \q será alto y levantado, y muy enaltecido.
es.B: {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo actuará con sabiduría y tendrá éxito. \q Será levantado y ensalzado; estará muy en alto.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}! Mi siervo hará lo que es sabio, y tendrá éxito. \q Será levantado y honrado. Se le dará el lugar más alto.

fr.L: Voici, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur agira avec sagesse ; \q il sera haut et élevé, et très exalté.
fr.B: Voici, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur agira avec intelligence et réussira. \q Il s’élèvera, il sera haut placé ; il sera très grand.
fr.R: Regardez ! Mon serviteur agira avec sagesse, et il réussira. \q Il sera élevé et honoré. On lui donnera la place la plus haute.

sw.L: Tazama, mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} atatenda kwa hekima; \q atakuwa juu na kuinuliwa, na kutukuzwa sana.
sw.B: Tazama, mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} atatenda kwa busara na kufanikiwa. \q Atainuka na kupandishwa juu; atasimama juu sana.
sw.R: Tazama! Mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} atatenda kwa hekima, naye atafanikiwa. \q Atainuliwa na kuheshimiwa. Atapewa nafasi iliyo juu kuliko zote.

vi.L: Kìa, đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ hành động khôn ngoan; \q người sẽ được cao trọng và được nâng lên, và được tôn cao tột bậc.
vi.B: Kìa, đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ hành động sáng suốt và thành công. \q Người sẽ vươn lên và được nâng cao; người sẽ đứng ở nơi rất cao.
vi.R: Hãy xem! Đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm điều khôn ngoan, và người sẽ thành công. \q Người sẽ được nâng lên và được tôn trọng. Người sẽ được đặt ở chỗ cao nhất.

ko.L: 보라, 나의 종이 지혜롭게 행할 것이다. \q 그가 높아지고 들려 올라가 매우 높여질 것이다.
ko.B: 보아라, 내 종이 슬기롭게 행하여 뜻을 이룰 것이다. \q 그가 일어나 높이 들리고, 아주 높은 자리에 설 것이다.
ko.R: 보아라! 내 종이 지혜롭게 일하여 성공할 것이다. \q 그가 높이 들어 올려지고 존귀하게 될 것이다. 그가 가장 높은 자리에 오를 것이다.

pt.L: Eis que o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} servo agirá com entendimento; \q ele estará alto e elevado, e muito exaltado.
pt.B: Vejam, o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} servo agirá com discernimento e terá êxito. \q Ele subirá e será elevado; ficará muito acima de todos.
pt.R: Vejam! O {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} servo vai fazer o que é sábio e vai ter sucesso. \q Ele vai ser elevado e honrado. Vai receber o lugar mais alto.

am.L: እነሆ፣ ባሪያዬ በጥበብ ያደርጋል፤ \q ከፍ ይላል፤ ይነሣል፤ እጅግም ይላቃል።
am.B: ተመልከቱ፣ አገልጋዬ በማስተዋል ይሠራል፤ ይከናወንለታልም። \q ይነሣል፤ ከፍ ይደረጋል፤ እጅግ ከፍ ባለ ስፍራም ይቆማል።
am.R: ተመልከቱ! አገልጋዬ በጥበብ ይሠራል፤ ይሳካለታልም። \q ከፍ ይደረጋል፤ ይከበራልም። ከሁሉ የላቀውን ስፍራ ይሰጠዋል።

hi.L: देखो, मेरा दास बुद्धिमानी से काम करेगा; \q वह ऊँचा और उन्नत होगा, और अत्यंत महान ठहरेगा।
hi.B: देखो, मेरा दास समझदारी से काम करेगा और सफल होगा। \q वह उठाया जाएगा और ऊँचा किया जाएगा; वह बहुत ऊँचे स्थान पर होगा।
hi.R: देखो! मेरा दास बुद्धिमानी का काम करेगा, और वह सफल होगा। \q उसे ऊपर उठाया जाएगा और आदर दिया जाएगा। उसे सबसे ऊँचा स्थान दिया जाएगा।

ru.L: Вот, {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} раб будет поступать мудро; \q он будет высок, и вознесён, и чрезвычайно возвеличен.
ru.B: Вот, {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} раб будет действовать с разумением и преуспеет. \q Он поднимется и вознесётся; он будет стоять очень высоко.
ru.R: Смотрите! Мой раб будет поступать мудро, и он добьётся успеха. \q Его поднимут и окажут ему честь. Ему дадут самое высокое место.

ja.L: 見なさい、わたしのしもべは賢く振る舞う。 \q 彼は高くされ、上げられ、はなはだ高められる。
ja.B: 見なさい、わたしのしもべは悟りをもって事を行い、栄える。 \q 彼は高く上げられ、はるかに高められる。
ja.R: 見なさい！わたしのしもべは賢く行い、成功する。 \q この者は高く上げられ、誉れを受ける。最も高い地位が与えられる。

decisions.choice: my servant: the start of the song of the servant that runs to 53:12
decisions.reason: Verses 13-15 and chapter 53 form one poem about the servant who suffers and is exalted. On who the servant is, see the note at 41:8: the word can name the people Israel or a figure with a mission to them (49:5-6). This servant suffers for the sins of others (53:4-6). The New Testament reads the song as fulfilled in Jesus (Acts 8:32-35; 1 Peter 2:22-25).

decisions.choice: act wisely: act with insight and so succeed
decisions.reason: The verb means to have understanding and also to prosper as its result (Joshua 1:8; 1 Samuel 18:14-15). Jeremiah 23:5 uses it of the righteous king from David's line.

decisions.choice: high and lifted up: the words used of the Lord's throne
decisions.reason: Isaiah saw the Lord "high and lifted up" (6:1), and 57:15 calls God "the high and lifted up One". The servant, rejected and disfigured (52:14; 53:3), is raised to the same height.

decisions.choice: act with insight and succeed
decisions.reason: Balanced gives both sides of the verb, wise action and its success.

decisions.choice: He will be raised up and honored. He will be given the highest place.
decisions.reason: Readable says what being high and lifted up means: honor and the highest rank.

decisions.choice: él, su (the servant; no deity_pronoun span)
decisions.reason: In the servant song of 52:13-53:12 the servant's pronouns take no deity_pronoun span, as the terms note sets; God's "mi" does. Acts 8:32-33 and 1 Peter 2:22-24, which span Jesus, are not followed here.

decisions.choice: mtumishi wangu
decisions.reason: The song of the suffering servant runs from here to 53:12. It is drafted from the Hebrew and the gloss, and the New Testament quotations (Acts 8:32-33; John 12:38; Romans 10:16; 1 Peter 2:22-24) are followed only in their key words.

decisions.choice: "mon serviteur ... il" (no deity_pronoun span on the servant)
decisions.reason: Through 52:13-53:12 the servant's pronouns take no deity_pronoun span, as in the English and the terms note, although the New Testament reads the song of Jesus (Acts 8:32-35); God's own pronouns keep theirs.

decisions.choice: the servant is "người", lowercase, with no span, through 52:13-53:12
decisions.reason: As at 42:1: in Isaiah the servant takes no deity_pronoun span; Acts 8:32-33 spans the pronoun only because the New Testament applies these words to Jesus. The passage was drafted from the Hebrew gloss, keeping clear of familiar Vietnamese wording.

decisions.choice: "높아지고 들려 올라가" (L) with the servant as plain "그" through 52:13-53:12
alternatives: "높이 들리다" alone; the honorific for the servant
decisions.reason: The words echo "high and lifted up" said of the Lord's throne in 6:1 (m3), so Literal keeps both verbs; as the terms note sets (Acts 8:32-33), the servant takes no -시- anywhere in the song, so the Korean does not decide who he is.

decisions.choice: o meu servo, drafted from the Hebrew
decisions.reason: For 52:13-53:12, the best-known passage of the book: every line is drafted from the Hebrew and the gloss, and any line that came out close to a familiar Portuguese version beyond a short phrase was rewritten. The servant is "o meu servo" at every level, as in 42:1 and 49:3; pronouns for the servant take no deity_pronoun setting, as in the English.

decisions.choice: Eis que o meu servo (L); alto e elevado, e muito exaltado (L); elevado (B, R)
decisions.reason: The servant is presented at Literal as in 42:1 ("Eis o meu servo"), with "eis que" for the particle as the book sets it (3:1). "Alto e elevado" repeats the words of the throne in 6:1 and of God in 57:15, as the book records at 6:1; the third verb, "exalted", is "exaltado", so that "elevado" stays for nasa'.

decisions.choice: Isaiah 52:13-53:12 drafted fresh from the Hebrew
alternatives: the wording of the 1962 Amharic Bible
decisions.reason: This song is the best-remembered passage of Isaiah in Amharic. It is drafted from the Hebrew and the meaning decisions, and lines that matched the 1962 Bible beyond a short common phrase were reworded; the New Testament quotations keep the Amharic New Testament's wording where the Hebrew agrees with the Greek. The servant is "ባሪያዬ" (L), "አገልጋዬ" (B, R), as in 49:3.

decisions.choice: मेरा दास, with plain forms (वह, उसका)
decisions.reason: The servant song 52:13-53:12 is drafted from the Hebrew and its gloss, not from an earlier Hindi version. The servant takes plain singular forms, as Acts 8:32-33 and Luke 22:37 have them where they quote the song; Matthew 8:17 and 1 Peter 2:22-24, which speak of Jesus in their own narrative, use the honorific, and their words are kept here with the plain forms.

decisions.choice: ऊँचा और उन्नत होगा, और अत्यंत महान ठहरेगा
decisions.reason: The first pair is used of the Lord in 6:1 and 57:15 ("high and lifted up"); Literal keeps the three verbs and renders the pair ऊँचा और उन्नत, as in 57:7 and 57:15, so the echo can be heard.

decisions.choice: он, его (the servant) without spans, from 52:13 to 53:12
decisions.reason: As in the English, the servant's pronouns in this song take no deity pronoun setting: the song speaks of "my servant", and the reader is left to see whom it describes. Where the New Testament quotes its lines of Jesus (Acts 8:32-33, 1 Peter 2:22-24), its own text carries the spans; God's "my" here takes one.

decisions.choice: высок, и вознесён
decisions.reason: "High and lifted up" are the words used of the Lord's throne in 6:1 (m3); Literal keeps the pair so that the echo can be heard.

decisions.choice: The fourth Servant Song (52:13-53:12): "わたしのしもべ" at every level, the servant "彼" (L, B) and "この者" (R) with plain verbs, never "その方" (ISA-6 42:1); God speaks in 52:13-15 and 53:11-12 plainly, the "we" of 53:1-10 speak plainly in verse with light respect forms for the LORD only.
decisions.reason: The settled ISA-6 conventions for the Servant Songs; the NT applies the song to Jesus, but Isaiah's Japanese keeps the forms of the Hebrew poem.

decisions.choice: yaskil "賢く振る舞う" (L), "悟りをもって事を行い、栄える" (B), "賢く行い、成功する" (R) (m2); yarum venissa' "高くされ、上げられ" (L), "高く上げられ" (B, R), the words of 6:1 ("高く上げられた王座") and 57:15 (m3).
decisions.reason: The echo of the Lord's throne is kept by the same verb.

source.text: כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר שָׁמְמ֤וּ עָלֶ֨יךָ֙ רַבִּ֔ים כֵּן־מִשְׁחַ֥ת מֵאִ֖ישׁ מַרְאֵ֑הוּ וְתֹאֲר֖וֹ מִבְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Just as were appalled at you many, so [was] disfigured beyond a man his appearance, and his form beyond [the] sons of humankind,

en.L: Just as many were appalled at you \q (so disfigured beyond [that of] a man [was] his appearance, \q and his form beyond [that of] the {{gender:children|sons}} of humankind),
en.B: Just as many stared at you in horror \q (his appearance so ruined it no longer seemed a man's, \q his form so marred it hardly looked human),
en.R: Many people were shocked when they saw him. \q His face and body were so disfigured that he hardly looked human.

es.L: Así como muchos se espantaron de ti \q (tan desfigurado, más que [el de] cualquier hombre, [estaba] su aspecto, \q y su figura más que [la de] los hijos de los hombres),
es.B: Así como muchos se horrorizaron al verte \q (su aspecto estaba tan arruinado que ya no parecía de hombre, \q su figura tan desfigurada que apenas parecía humana),
es.R: Mucha gente se espantó cuando lo vio. \q Su cara y su cuerpo estaban tan desfigurados que apenas parecía humano.

fr.L: De même que beaucoup ont été consternés à ton sujet \q (tant son aspect était défiguré, plus que [celui d’]un homme, \q et sa forme plus que [celle] des {{gender:enfants des humains|fils des hommes}}),
fr.B: De même que beaucoup t’ont regardé avec horreur \q (son aspect était si abîmé qu’il ne semblait plus celui d’un homme, \q sa forme si défigurée qu’il avait à peine l’air humain),
fr.R: Beaucoup de gens ont été bouleversés en le voyant. \q Son visage et son corps étaient si défigurés qu’il avait à peine l’air humain.

sw.L: Kama vile wengi walivyokushangaa \q (hivyo kuharibika kwake kulikuwa kupita [kwa] mtu [yeyote] sura yake, \q na umbo lake kupita [la] wanadamu),
sw.B: Kama vile wengi walivyokutazama kwa hofu kuu \q (sura yake ilikuwa imeharibika mno hata haikufanana tena na ya mtu, \q umbo lake limeharibika hata halikuonekana kuwa la binadamu),
sw.R: Watu wengi walishtuka walipomwona. \q Uso wake na mwili wake viliharibiwa sana hata hakuonekana kama binadamu.

vi.L: Như nhiều người đã kinh hãi về ngươi \q (dung mạo người bị biến dạng hơn [mọi] người, \q và hình dáng người hơn [mọi] con cái loài người),
vi.B: Cũng như nhiều người đã sững sờ kinh hãi khi nhìn ngươi \q (dung mạo người tàn tạ đến nỗi không còn giống người, \q hình dáng người hư hại đến nỗi khó nhận ra là con người),
vi.R: Nhiều người đã bàng hoàng khi nhìn thấy người. \q Mặt mày và thân thể người bị biến dạng đến nỗi người hầu như không còn giống con người nữa.

ko.L: 많은 사람이 너를 보고 놀랐던 것처럼, \q (그의 모습이 사람보다 더 상했고, \q 그의 형체가 사람의 {{gender:자녀들|아들들}}보다 더 [상했다].)
ko.B: 많은 사람이 너를 보고 몸서리쳤던 것처럼, \q (그의 모습은 너무 망가져서 사람의 모습 같지 않았고, \q 그의 형체는 너무 상해서 사람처럼 보이지 않았다.)
ko.R: 많은 사람이 그를 보고 충격을 받았다. \q 그의 얼굴과 몸이 너무 상해서 사람처럼 보이지도 않았다.

pt.L: Assim como muitos ficaram espantados diante de ti \q (tão desfigurada, mais que [a de] um homem, [estava] a sua aparência, \q e a sua figura, mais que [a dos] {{gender:filhos da humanidade|filhos dos homens}}),
pt.B: Assim como muitos olharam para ti horrorizados \q (a sua aparência estava tão arruinada que já não parecia de homem, \q e a sua figura, tão estragada que quase não tinha forma humana),
pt.R: Muitas pessoas ficaram chocadas quando o viram. \q O rosto e o corpo dele estavam tão deformados que ele quase nem parecia gente.

am.L: ብዙዎች በአንተ እንደ ደነገጡ፣ \q (መልኩ ከሰው [መልክ] ይልቅ እንዲሁ ተዛብቶ፣ \q ቁመናውም ከሰው ልጆች [ቁመና] ይልቅ [ተዛብቶ ነበርና])፣
am.B: ብዙዎች አንተን አይተው በድንጋጤ እንደ ተመለከቱ፣ \q (መልኩ የሰው መልክ እስከማይመስል ድረስ ተበላሽቶ፣ \q ቁመናውም ሰው እስከማይመስል ድረስ ተጎሳቁሎ ነበርና)፣
am.R: ብዙ ሰዎች ባዩት ጊዜ ደነገጡ። \q ፊቱና አካሉ እጅግ ተበላሽቶ ስለ ነበር ሰው አይመስልም ነበር።

hi.L: जैसे बहुत से लोग तुम्हें देखकर चकित हुए \q (उसका रूप ऐसा बिगड़ा कि [किसी] मनुष्य का-सा न रहा, \q और उसका आकार {{gender:मनुष्य की सन्तान|मनुष्य के पुत्रों}} से [भिन्न हो गया]),
hi.B: जैसे बहुत से लोग तुम्हें देखकर भौचक्के रह गए \q (उसका रूप ऐसा बिगड़ गया था कि वह मनुष्य का-सा नहीं लगता था, \q उसका आकार ऐसा बिगड़ा कि वह मानव जैसा भी नहीं दिखता था),
hi.R: बहुत से लोग उसे देखकर हक्के-बक्के रह गए। \q उसका चेहरा और शरीर इतना बिगड़ गया था कि वह मुश्किल से मनुष्य जैसा दिखता था।

ru.L: Как многие ужаснулись при виде тебя \q (так обезображен был его облик — более, чем [у] человека, \q и его вид — более, чем [у] {{gender:детей человеческих|сынов человеческих}}),
ru.B: Как многие с ужасом смотрели на тебя \q (его облик был так изуродован, что уже не походил на человеческий, \q его вид был так искажён, что он едва походил на человека),
ru.R: Многие были потрясены, когда увидели его. \q Его лицо и тело были так изуродованы, что он едва походил на человека.

ja.L: 多くの者があなたに驚きあきれたように―― \q 彼の姿は人と違うほどに損なわれ、 \q その形は人々と違うほどであった――
ja.B: 多くの者が、あなたを見て恐れおののいたように、 \q ――その姿は損なわれて、もはや人とは見えず、 \q その形は崩れて、人間らしくなかった――
ja.R: 多くの人々は、この者を見て、ひどく驚いた。 \q その顔も体も、ひどく損なわれていて、ほとんど人間には見えなかった。

decisions.choice: at you: God turns for a moment to speak to the servant
decisions.reason: The poem speaks of the servant as "he" before and after this line. The sudden "you" is God addressing him directly. Some ancient versions read "at him" (the Syriac and the Targum, from memory, to be checked).

decisions.choice: disfigurement: the servant's appearance was ruined
decisions.reason: The Masoretic Text has a noun meaning "disfigurement". The Great Isaiah Scroll (1QIsa-a) has letters that can be read "I anointed" (from memory, to be checked), giving "I anointed his appearance beyond any man". The Masoretic reading fits the shock of the onlookers and 53:2-3.

decisions.choice: just as ... so: the comparison runs into verse 15
decisions.reason: "Just as many were appalled" is completed by "so he will sprinkle many nations" in verse 15. The words about his appearance are an aside explaining why they were appalled.

decisions.choice: when they saw him
decisions.reason: Readable keeps "him" throughout, since the sudden "you" refers to the same servant and would confuse a new reader.

decisions.choice: His face and body
decisions.reason: Readable uses "face" for his appearance and "body" for his form.

decisions.choice: diante de ti, para ti (tu)
decisions.reason: God turns for a moment to speak to the servant (m1), so Literal and Balanced say "ti", as God speaks to one person with "tu"; Readable keeps "o viram", as the English Readable keeps "him".

decisions.choice: No gender span: "የሰው ልጆች"
decisions.reason: The English offers "children" or "sons" of humankind; Amharic "የሰው ልጆች" already means human beings of either sex.

decisions.choice: तुम्हें (God to the servant)
decisions.reason: God turns for a moment to speak to the servant; he addresses him with तुम, as in 42:6 and 49:3-8, the one form for God's words to the servant through chapters 42-53 (see 49:3). Readable keeps "him", as the English does.

decisions.choice: gender span मनुष्य की सन्तान / मनुष्य के पुत्रों
decisions.reason: The English has a gender span on "sons of humankind"; Hindi uses the Psalms form, children of man by default and sons of man as the alternative.

decisions.choice: {{gender:детей человеческих|сынов человеческих}}
decisions.reason: Bene adam at Literal takes the gender setting in the poetry note's form, as the English does.

decisions.choice: God turns briefly to the servant ("あなた", m1); the parenthesis of the English L and B is set between dashes, and "Just as … so" (m3) runs on into 52:15 ("そのように").
decisions.reason: Japanese has no round-bracket convention here; dashes mark the aside.

decisions.choice: bene 'adam "人々" (L), "人間" (B) with no gender span, where the English has {{gender:children|sons}}: the Japanese is already inclusive, and "人の子ら" is avoided so as not to suggest the NT title 人の子.
decisions.reason: No alternative is needed in Japanese.

source.text: כֵּ֤ן יַזֶּה֙ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֔ים עָלָ֛יו יִקְפְּצ֥וּ מְלָכִ֖ים פִּיהֶ֑ם כִּ֠י אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־סֻפַּ֤ר לָהֶם֙ רָא֔וּ וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־שָׁמְע֖וּ הִתְבּוֹנָֽנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: so he will sprinkle nations many; at him will shut kings their mouth, for what not had been recounted to them they will see, and what not they had heard they will understand.

en.L: so he will sprinkle many nations; \q at him kings will shut their mouths, \q for what had not been told them they will see, \q and what they had not heard they will understand.
en.B: so he will sprinkle many nations. \q Kings will fall silent before him, \q for they will see a thing no one ever told them \q and grasp a thing they never heard.
en.R: In the same way, he will sprinkle many nations to make them clean. \q Kings will be so amazed at him that they cannot speak. \q They will see things no one ever told them. \q They will understand things they never heard before.

es.L: así rociará a muchas naciones; \q ante él los reyes cerrarán la boca, \q porque verán lo que no se les había contado, \q y entenderán lo que no habían oído.
es.B: así rociará a muchas naciones. \q Los reyes se quedarán sin palabras ante él, \q porque verán algo que nadie les había contado \q y comprenderán algo que nunca habían oído.
es.R: De la misma manera, rociará a muchas naciones para purificarlas. \q Los reyes quedarán tan asombrados ante él que no podrán hablar. \q Verán cosas que nadie les había contado. \q Entenderán cosas que nunca antes habían oído.

fr.L: ainsi il aspergera des nations nombreuses ; \q devant lui des rois fermeront la bouche, \q car ce qui ne leur avait pas été raconté, ils le verront, \q et ce qu’ils n’avaient pas entendu, ils le comprendront.
fr.B: ainsi il aspergera des nations nombreuses. \q Devant lui des rois resteront muets, \q car ils verront ce qu’on ne leur avait jamais raconté \q et comprendront ce qu’ils n’avaient jamais entendu.
fr.R: De la même manière, il aspergera beaucoup de nations pour les rendre pures. \q Des rois seront si étonnés devant lui qu’ils ne pourront rien dire. \q Ils verront des choses que personne ne leur avait jamais racontées. \q Ils comprendront des choses dont ils n’avaient jamais entendu parler.

sw.L: ndivyo atakavyonyunyizia mataifa mengi; \q kwa ajili yake wafalme watafumba vinywa vyao, \q kwa maana yale ambayo hawakuambiwa wataona, \q na yale ambayo hawakusikia wataelewa.
sw.B: ndivyo atakavyonyunyizia mataifa mengi. \q Wafalme watanyamaza kimya mbele yake, \q kwa maana wataona jambo ambalo hakuna mtu aliyewahi kuwaambia, \q na kuelewa jambo ambalo hawakuwahi kulisikia.
sw.R: Vivyo hivyo, atanyunyizia mataifa mengi ili kuyatakasa. \q Wafalme watashangaa sana juu yake hata hawataweza kusema. \q Wataona mambo ambayo hakuna mtu aliyewahi kuwaambia. \q Wataelewa mambo ambayo hawakuwahi kusikia hapo kabla.

vi.L: thì người cũng sẽ rảy nhiều dân tộc; \q các vua sẽ ngậm miệng lại vì người, \q vì điều chưa ai thuật lại cho họ, họ sẽ thấy, \q và điều họ chưa từng nghe, họ sẽ hiểu.
vi.B: thì người cũng sẽ rảy nước trên nhiều dân tộc. \q Các vua sẽ câm lặng trước mặt người, \q vì họ sẽ thấy điều chưa ai từng kể cho họ \q và hiểu điều họ chưa bao giờ nghe.
vi.R: Cũng vậy, người sẽ rảy nước trên nhiều dân tộc để làm cho họ được tinh sạch. \q Các vua sẽ kinh ngạc về người đến nỗi không nói nên lời. \q Họ sẽ thấy những điều chưa ai từng kể cho họ. \q Họ sẽ hiểu những điều trước đây họ chưa từng nghe.

ko.L: 그렇게 그가 많은 민족들에게 뿌릴 것이다. \q 그 앞에서 왕들이 그들의 입을 다물 것이다. \q 그들에게 이야기되지 않았던 것을 그들이 보고, \q 그들이 듣지 못했던 것을 깨달을 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그와 같이 그가 많은 민족에게 뿌릴 것이다. \q 왕들이 그 앞에서 입을 다물 것이다. \q 그들은 아무도 말해 주지 않은 것을 보고, \q 한 번도 들어 보지 못한 것을 깨달을 것이다.
ko.R: 그와 같이 그가 많은 민족에게 물을 뿌려 그들을 깨끗하게 할 것이다. \q 왕들이 그를 보고 너무 놀라서 말을 하지 못할 것이다. \q 그들은 아무도 말해 주지 않은 것을 볼 것이다. \q 그들은 한 번도 들어 보지 못한 것을 깨달을 것이다.

pt.L: assim ele aspergirá muitas nações; \q diante dele reis fecharão a boca, \q pois o que não lhes tinha sido anunciado verão, \q e o que não tinham ouvido entenderão.
pt.B: assim ele aspergirá muitas nações. \q Reis ficarão calados diante dele, \q pois verão algo que ninguém nunca lhes contou \q e entenderão algo que nunca ouviram.
pt.R: Do mesmo jeito, ele vai borrifar muitas nações para torná-las puras. \q Reis vão ficar tão espantados com ele que não vão conseguir falar. \q Vão ver coisas que ninguém nunca contou a eles. \q Vão entender coisas que nunca ouviram antes.

am.L: እንዲሁ ብዙ ሕዝቦችን ይረጫል፤ \q ነገሥታትም በእርሱ ምክንያት አፋቸውን ይዘጋሉ፤ \q ያልተነገራቸውን ያያሉና፤ \q ያልሰሙትንም ያስተውላሉ።
am.B: እንዲሁ ብዙ ሕዝቦችን ይረጫል። \q ነገሥታት በፊቱ ዝም ይላሉ፤ \q ማንም ያልነገራቸውን ነገር ያያሉና፤ \q ፈጽሞ ያልሰሙትንም ነገር ያስተውላሉ።
am.R: እንደዚሁም ብዙ ሕዝቦችን ለማንጻት ይረጫቸዋል። \q ነገሥታት በእርሱ እጅግ ተደንቀው መናገር ያቅታቸዋል። \q ማንም ያልነገራቸውን ነገሮች ያያሉ። \q ከዚህ በፊት ያልሰሙትን ነገሮች ይረዳሉ።

hi.L: वैसे ही वह बहुत सी जातियों पर छिड़काव करेगा; \q उसके कारण राजा अपना मुँह बंद करेंगे, \q क्योंकि जो उन्हें नहीं बताया गया था, वह वे देखेंगे, \q और जो उन्होंने नहीं सुना था, वह वे समझेंगे।
hi.B: वैसे ही वह बहुत से देशों पर छिड़काव करेगा। \q राजा उसके सामने चुप हो जाएँगे, \q क्योंकि वे वह देखेंगे जिसके बारे में उन्हें कभी नहीं बताया गया, \q और वह समझेंगे जो उन्होंने कभी नहीं सुना।
hi.R: उसी तरह वह बहुत से देशों पर छिड़काव करेगा कि उन्हें शुद्ध करे। \q राजा उसे देखकर इतने चकित होंगे कि कुछ बोल न सकेंगे। \q वे ऐसी बातें देखेंगे जिनके बारे में उन्हें कभी नहीं बताया गया। \q वे ऐसी बातें समझेंगे जो उन्होंने पहले कभी नहीं सुनीं।

ru.L: так он окропит многие народы; \q перед ним цари закроют свои уста, \q ведь то, что не было возвещено им, они увидят, \q и то, чего они не слышали, поймут.
ru.B: так он окропит многие народы. \q Цари умолкнут перед ним, \q ведь они увидят то, о чём им никогда не рассказывали, \q и поймут то, чего никогда не слышали.
ru.R: Так и он окропит многие народы, чтобы очистить их. \q Цари будут так изумлены им, что не смогут говорить. \q Они увидят то, о чём им никто никогда не рассказывал. \q Они поймут то, чего никогда раньше не слышали.

ja.L: そのように、彼は多くの国々に振りかける。 \q 彼のゆえに、王たちは口を閉ざす。 \q 彼らは、告げられなかったことを見、 \q 聞かなかったことを悟るからだ。
ja.B: そのように、彼は多くの国々に振りかける。 \q 王たちは、彼の前で口をつぐむ。 \q だれも彼らに告げなかったことを、彼らは見、 \q 聞いたこともなかったことを、悟るからだ。
ja.R: 同じように、この者は、多くの国々を清めるために、振りかける。 \q 王たちはこの者を見て、驚きのあまり、ものも言えなくなる。 \q 彼らは、だれも教えてくれなかったことを見る。 \q 一度も聞いたことのなかったことを、悟る。

decisions.choice: sprinkle: the priestly act of sprinkling to cleanse
decisions.reason: Everywhere else in the Bible this verb means to sprinkle blood, oil or water to make clean or holy (Leviticus 4:6; 14:7; 16:14). That suits a servant whose life is made a guilt offering (53:10). But here nothing is named as sprinkled, and the parallel with "appalled" in verse 14 suggests a meaning such as "startle", which the Septuagint's "many nations will marvel at him" supports (from memory, to be checked).

decisions.choice: kings will shut their mouths: they are struck silent with awe
decisions.reason: Shutting the mouth is the response of people overwhelmed by what they see (Job 29:9-10; Micah 7:16). Kings who once looked away from the servant now stand speechless before him.

decisions.choice: what they were not told they will see: news of the servant reaches those who never heard
decisions.reason: Paul quotes this line in its Greek form to explain why he preached where Christ had not been named (Romans 15:21).

decisions.choice: to make them clean
decisions.reason: Readable says why sprinkling was done in Israel's worship. Since the sense of the verb here is uncertain, this explanation is uncertain too.

decisions.choice: so amazed at him that they cannot speak
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of shutting the mouth.

decisions.choice: "뿌릴 것이다" for yazzeh, the priestly sprinkling
decisions.reason: The Korean follows the Hebrew verb, as the English and the meaning decision (m1) do; the "startle" of other versions follows the Greek.

decisions.choice: anunciado ... verão ... ouvido entenderão, as Romans 15:21
decisions.reason: Paul quotes the last two lines in Romans 15:21 (m3) from the Greek, which says "those to whom nothing was announced"; the Hebrew says "what had not been told them". Isaiah follows the Hebrew and keeps Romans' verbs, "anunciado" (L), "verão", "ouviram", "entenderão". "Aspergir" is the priestly word for sprinkling to cleanse (m1); Readable says "borrifar", the everyday word.

decisions.choice: Romans 15:21 kept: "ያያሉ ... ያስተውላሉ" (R "ይረዳሉ"); the Hebrew "what" followed
decisions.reason: Paul (Romans 15:21) quotes the Greek, which speaks of the people "to whom nothing was told about him"; the Hebrew speaks of the thing "that had not been told them". The Amharic keeps Romans' verbs and follows the Hebrew with the object marker ("ያልተነገራቸውን").

decisions.choice: नहीं बताया गया ... देखेंगे; नहीं सुना ... समझेंगे
decisions.reason: Romans 15:21 quotes these lines in their Greek form ("those to whom it was not told about him"); the Hebrew has "what" was not told, so the object follows the Hebrew while the verbs keep the wording of Romans.

decisions.choice: छिड़काव करेगा
decisions.reason: Everywhere else the verb means to sprinkle to cleanse (Leviticus 4:6; 16:14); Hindi keeps the priestly act, as the English and the meaning decision do.

decisions.choice: то, что не было возвещено им, они увидят (L); то, о чём им никогда не рассказывали (B, R)
alternatives: Те, кому не было возвещено о нём, увидят
decisions.reason: Romans 15:21 quotes these lines from the Greek Old Testament, which speaks of the people ("those who were not told about him"); the Hebrew speaks of the thing ("what they were not told"). Russian translates the Hebrew and keeps the verbs of Romans at each level (возвещено, увидят, поймут; рассказывали, слышали).

decisions.choice: окропит
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb is the priestly word for sprinkling to cleanse (m1); the Greek Old Testament has "many nations will marvel at him". Russian keeps "sprinkle", as the English does, and Readable's "to make them clean" is as uncertain as the English decision says.

decisions.choice: yazzeh "振りかける" (every level), the priestly sprinkling (m1; LEV), Readable adding "清めるために" as its English.
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the priestly verb, not "startle".

decisions.choice: "what had not been told them they will see" from the Hebrew (things, not persons); checked against ROM 15:21, which quotes the Greek ("those who were not told about him").
decisions.reason: The Hebrew and the Greek differ in the subject; Isaiah follows the Hebrew.
